entries.zh: 许愿；向天主或神明许愿立誓

entries.notes: L「hacer voto」+H「許」+R hù guān（許願）互证清晰；M栏「愈」与义不合（或涉病愈还愿语境），据L/H/R定许愿义

entries.en: to shout in rebuke; scornful cry of refusal ('pui!')

entries.en: noise of tumult; clamor; uproar
